term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger system is a small ground robot that travels in a straight line and turns in place when it detects an obstacle. The robot carries a single infrared (IR) distance sensor mounted facing forward and a differential-drive motor pair that accepts a combined linear / angular velocity command. The controller is reactive: its only sensor input is the IR-driven obstacle event; a system-level endTask event is available to halt the controller. The controller issues motor commands as advisory events to the differential-drive layer.
term_trace.Concept_description: The SRanger system is a small ground robot that travels in a straight line and turns in place when it detects an obstacle.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller is composed of: (1) a Sensor interface that exposes the latest IR distance reading, (2) an Actuator interface that records the last motor command, (3) a small set of state variables (notably a clock-reset timestamp for the timed Turning → Moving transition), and (4) a single state machine that selects transitions based on the input event, the IR distance, and the elapsed time in the current mode.
term_trace.Concept_description: The SRanger controller is composed of a Sensor interface, an Actuator interface, state variables, and a single state machine.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller has exactly three operating modes: Moving (initial mode — the robot drives forward at the configured linear velocity), Turning (the robot rotates in place at the configured angular velocity), and Final (a terminal mode entered when the operator issues endTask). At start-up the controller is in Moving.
term_trace.Concept_description: An operating mode of the SRanger controller.
term_trace.Instance_description: Initial mode in which the robot drives forward at the configured linear velocity.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller defines four real-valued constants: moveVel (default 1.0, m/s — linear velocity command when Moving), turnVel (default 2.0, rad/s — angular velocity command when Turning), obstacleThreshold (default 0.5, metres — IR-distance threshold for the obstacle-detection condition), and turnDuration (default 2.0, seconds — how long the controller remains in Turning before returning to Moving). All four are fixed configuration constants for the controller.
term_trace.Concept_description: A real-valued fixed configuration constant used by the SRanger controller.
term_trace.Instance_description: Default 1.0 m/s; linear velocity command when Moving.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller receives input events from three sources. obstacle (signal, no payload) — emitted by the IR sensor framework when the distance reading crosses below obstacleThreshold. tick (signal, no payload) — delivered each control cycle by the system framework. endTask (signal, no payload) — emitted by the operator-level shutdown channel to terminate the controller into Final.
term_trace.Concept_description: An input event received by the SRanger controller from three sources.
term_trace.Instance_description: Emitted by the IR sensor framework when the distance reading crosses below obstacleThreshold.

term_trace.Requirement: The SRanger controller emits a single output event, Move, carrying two real values — a linear velocity and an angular velocity — a combined command to the differential-drive layer. The same event covers forward motion (Move(moveVel, 0)), turning in place (Move(0, turnVel)), and stopping (Move(0, 0)); the controller introduces no other output events.
term_trace.Concept_description: An output event emitted by the SRanger controller.
term_trace.Instance_description: Single output event carrying linear and angular velocity to the differential-drive layer.

term_trace.Requirement: The Sensor exposes the latest IR distance reading: distance() returns a real number in metres, non-negative. When no reading is available (e.g., the sensor has not yet been initialised), distance() returns a large default value so that the obstacle-detection condition is not falsely triggered by missing data.
term_trace.Concept_description: The Sensor exposes the latest IR distance reading.

term_trace.Requirement: The Actuator receives Move(lv, av) events from the controller and stores the latest issued command. The Actuator exposes the last commanded linear and angular velocity for inspection. No other output channels exist.
term_trace.Concept_description: The Actuator receives Move(lv, av) events, stores the latest issued command, and exposes it for inspection.

term_trace.Requirement: The controller maintains a real variable clockResetTime (seconds) recording when the controller most recently entered the Turning state. It is set to the current time as an entry action on the Moving → Turning transition. The autonomous Turning → Moving transition fires when the elapsed time since clockResetTime is at or above turnDuration.
term_trace.Concept_description: A real variable maintained by the controller.
term_trace.Instance_description: Records when the controller most recently entered the Turning state; set on the Moving → Turning transition and used for the autonomous Turning → Moving transition.
